subject: Qualification: Deployment mode & PoC plan for ACME Corp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Qualification: Deployment mode & PoC next steps

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can align on PoC scope: 

Recap:
- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for customer-facing features, support 24/7 peak traffic, and meet data residency/compliance requirements.
- Current constraints: strict ACME data residency for PII, expected baseline traffic ~200 req/s with burst to 500 req/s, internal ATO gating for any external network access.

Deployment options we discussed:
1) Hosted API (Redwood-hosted): fastest to get started, no infra work from ACME, but may require data controls and contractual terms for residency.
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool): predictable throughput, network isolation, can be provisioned in your preferred cloud region — mixes performance and controls.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): full control for sensitive data, longer lead time and infra collaboration.

Proposed PoC / trial plan (high level):
- Goal: Demonstrate feasibility of chosen deployment mode with success criteria below.
- Timeline: 3-week technical trial (kickoff -> baseline tests -> scale validation -> review).
- Success criteria (examples — please confirm): p99 latency <200ms for 512-token responses, sustain 500 req/s for 5 minutes, and qualitative evaluation on result quality and cost per 1k tokens.
- Stakeholders needed from ACME: technical lead for infra, security reviewer for ATO, and a product owner to sign off on quality.

Can you confirm which deployment mode you want to prioritize for the PoC and any adjustments to the success criteria? Once we agree, I’ll send a detailed PoC plan and calendar invites. I’ve attached a one-page PoC plan draft and the Dedicated SLA for reference.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: poc-plan-acme.xlsx; redwood-dedicated-sla.pdf

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@acme-corp.com>, Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Qualification: Deployment mode & PoC next steps

Thanks Ben — great summary. We want to prioritize Dedicated capacity for the PoC. Main reasons: predictable throughput, ability to pin region for data residency, and closer parity with what we’d run in production.

A few clarifications / asks before we kick off:
- Success criteria (confirming): p99 latency <200ms (512 tokens), throughput validated at sustained 500 req/s, and a cost estimate for projected 1M tokens/month.
- Security / compliance: we need completed answers to our ATO checklist and evidence for logging/audit retention — please include the security worksheet.
- Stakeholders: Alicia Ramos (CTO), Michael Chen (Infra lead), Sarah Lopez (Product manager), and procurement@acme-corp.com for contracts.

Tentative timeline: we’re aiming to start the PoC week of Jan 17 if Redwood can deliver the Dedicated preview env by then. Please send a detailed plan + any access requests.

-Alicia
Alicia Ramos
CTO, ACME Corp
alicia.ramos@acme-corp.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-01-11T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Qualification: Deployment mode & PoC next steps

Hi Alicia — perfect, thanks for confirming Dedicated. Below is a concrete PoC plan and a checklist of what we need from ACME to hit your Jan 17 target.

PoC (3-week) plan (detailed):
Week 0 (Prep, 2 business days):
- Provision Dedicated capacity in the requested region
- Kickoff meeting, onboarding, and access provisioning
Week 1 (Baseline):
- Run baseline latency and correctness tests on sample prompts
- Validate model variant and tokenization settings
Week 2 (Scale):
- Load test to sustained 500 req/s and measure p50/p95/p99
- Validate KV/prefix caching and batching behavior
Week 3 (Review & Handover):
- Cost/perf analysis, runbook for production, and final signoff

Success criteria (final proposals):
- p99 latency <200ms for 512-token responses under normal operating conditions
- Sustained throughput 500 req/s (5-minute window) without error rate >1%
- Security: ATO checklist responses provided and logging/audit configurations verified
- Product: qualitative pass from Sarah on generation quality for core prompts

What we need from ACME:
- Test dataset / representative prompts and sample payloads (S3 or secure upload)
- Contact for VPN or VPC peering if you want private connectivity (name + network contact)
- Point person to approve production runbook (Sarah or a delegate)
- Procurement contact to process the trial/PO and MSA (procurement@acme-corp.com)

Attachments we’re sending: poc-plan-acme.xlsx (detailed tasks & timelines), redwood-dedicated-sla.pdf, security-answers-acme.xlsx (preliminary answers to your ATO).

Proposed kickoff: Jan 18, 10:00 AM ET (I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm). If Jan 17 start is required, we can shift prep to Jan 14–15 to meet that.

Let me know if you want Redwood to run an initial test on the Hosted API first while Dedicated is being provisioned — sometimes teams like to validate functionality quickly that way.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-01-12T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Qualification: Deployment mode & PoC next steps

Ben — thanks, this looks good. Confirming Jan 18, 10:00 AM ET for kickoff. Michael will be the technical owner for the trial and will work with your team on network setup. Procurement is looped for the short-term trial order and MSA — they asked for a DocuSign link for the SOW/MSA.

Success criteria confirmed except please include a cost target for 1M tokens/month (ballpark preferred) in the first-day materials so procurement has context. We’ll upload a zipped sample payload to the Drive link you shared by EOD Jan 14.

See you on the 18th — I’m copying Michael here to confirm readiness.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
CTO, ACME Corp

Attachments referenced: poc-plan-acme.xlsx; security-answers-acme.xlsx
